newsitem.title: USA: Arizona Public Palo Verde nuke at 62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arizona Public Palo Verde nuke at 62 pct.

text.p: Arizona Public Service's 1,221 megawatt (MW) Palo Verde 1 nuclear unit was operating at 62 percent power Tuesday morning for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its plant status report.
The unit is "holding power at this level to repair a low pressure feedwater heater tube leak," the NRC report stated.
The unit, in Wintersburg, Ariz., was operating at full power on Monday.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 1,221 MW, was running at full power, while unit 3, also rated at 1,221 MW, was still down for a refueling outage scheduled to end in early April.
Arizona Public Service is a unit of Pinnacle West Capital Corp.
